description: List the agent's connectors - the third-party systems it can call. Each carries a connection_status (PENDING_OAUTH, ACTIVE, EXPIRED or ERROR) worth checking before relying on its tools. Known limitation: this returns a BARE ARRAY, not an object with a `data` key.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

name: mba_list_connectors
title: List connectors
